verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes an eSignature REST API reference and Developer Center, plus official OpenAPI/Swagger specs on GitHub that 'allow both humans and computers to discover' the API. A community user also reports building a working proof of concept in Postman within an hour, so the API can be explored by running calls through external tools. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or has built-in runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI file served from the developer site. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive API explorer or 'try it' console, runnable code examples within the reference, a spec hosted on the developer site, and independent hands-on corroboration of an interactive reference.
